source: EELIS (Eesti looduse infosüsteem), Keskkonnaagentuur: kaitstavad looduse üksikobjektid
designation: kaitstav looduse üksikobjekt (protected individual natural object), state protection under the Nature Conservation Act
licence_proof: keskkonnaportaal.ee, the environment ministry's own portal, page updated 2026-05-26, read 2026-08-15: 'Avaandmete kasutamise tingimused on leitavad levituste juures ja keskkonna- ja ilma valdkonna andmed on väärtuslikud andmed (vastavalt avaandmete direktiivile) siis litsents on reeglina CC-BY 4.0.' Note 'reeglina' means 'as a rule', so this is a blanket portal statement rather than a per-dataset tag; the WFS carries no Fees or AccessConstraints element of its own.
attribution: EELIS (Eesti looduse infosüsteem), Keskkonnaagentuur, extract of 2026-08-15
scope: 1,065 protected individual natural objects nationwide; only the tree ones are kept here. The remainder are erratic boulders, springs, outcrops, karst and waterfalls.
caveat: No age, girth or vitality field: whether the tree still stands is a per-tree check the register cannot make. 'coord_basis' is the honest input to location_precision, since it says how the point was placed: GPS is surveyed, 'Eesti Põhikaart 1:10 000' was digitised off a 1:10,000 sheet and should default to approximate. Groups and avenues carry publishable=false under the collectible-point rule, not because they are unprotected.
